areas.label: Recover phase-5 invariant homes
areas.evidence: Original phase5 keeps shifted X at sp+0x13C, shifted Y in sl and -66 shifted16 in r9, with frame332. Persistent pointers to the actual signed offset globals and a shared shifted signed limit recover those homes and frame extent. The low result is carried into the shifted comparison so the original halfword wrap is preserved without an extra signed global reload. Shifted negative arithmetic uses unsigned shift operands; the bound is -66*0x10000. Cleanup to matching signed pointer spelling emits exactly identical normalized bytes and relocations to the audited machine code.

areas.evidence: 150 original-ROM comparisons cover cancellation yields1/62/303/424/600, first callback byte0/1/4, second byte0..4, synthetic busy patterns0/2 and A5 stack. Another120 run to full completion over first callback byte0/1/4, second byte0..4, busy patterns0/2, two synthetic RNG variants and zero/A5 stack. Calls, sprite payloads, non-stack RAM, return, saved registers and SP agree under clobbering helper stubs. All helpers remain stubbed. The producer bounds the second callback parameter (the source kind variable) to0..4, without proving it positive; the first byte controls falling rounds and is only sampled here. The existing target has no default for kind0 and remains inherited/uninitialized. The kind0 machine-code cases validate uniform seeded stack behavior only; arbitrary inherited memory, actual scheduler/render helpers and full C equivalence are unproven.
